$comment: Outbound allow-list for image builds behind Azure Firewall (egress.mode = firewall). Source addresses are filled in from the subnets.
containerInstance: the Image Builder container (Packer) calls Azure Resource Manager and Entra ID and writes build logs to the staging storage account.
buildVm: OS updates, Defender, Windows activation, and the Ubuntu/RHEL package repositories (RHUI is Red Hat's Azure update service for pay-as-you-go images).
Scripts and installers come from the image builder storage account over its private endpoint. Add FQDNs your own scripts download from.
